definitions.explanation: The construction and manufacturing of ships and boats.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{造船|ぞうせん}{業|ぎょう}で{栄|さか}えた。
examples.english: This town prospered through the shipbuilding industry.

examples.japanese: {造船|ぞうせん}{所|じょ}で{大型|おおがた}{船|せん}が{建造|けんぞう}されている。
examples.english: Large ships are being built at the shipyard.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{造船|ぞうせん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}だ。

notes:
{造船|ぞうせん} refers to the industry and process of building ships.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {造船|ぞうせん}{業|ぎょう}: shipbuilding industry
- {造船|ぞうせん}{所|じょ}: shipyard
- {造船|ぞうせん}{会社|がいしゃ}: shipbuilding company
- {造船|ぞうせん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: shipbuilding technology

RELATED WORDS:
- {建造|けんぞう}: construction (of ships, buildings)
- {船|ふね}: ship, boat
- ドック: dock

[Register: Formal/Technical]
